message: 魔王を知る者

name: Synn
message: 「Right clear, left clear. All clear. Nobody's here.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, duh, it's Sunday.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even on my day off, I can't help worrying about the Student Council. There's still plenty left to do, after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So you're one of those Student Council fanatics, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Say whatever you want.」
There doesn't seem to be anyone in the Student Council room either. Now's my chance!

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sneaking up behind me like that--not bad at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are *you* doing hiding your presence like that, Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Today is your day off, isn't it!? You're supposed to be resting at home.」

name: Synn
message: 「Look who's talking, Misa! Ria-senpai told you too, didn't she?! 'At least take today off'」

name: Synn
message: 「Shall we just pretend we never saw each other.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah. Just for today, I'll agree with you.」
Misa gathered up the documents and put them into her bag.

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm just going to head over to the shopping district for a bit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Have a good trip.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah~~ That scared me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Now we've got dirt on her.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, we're in the same boat here.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not the Demon Lord--*this* lord, yours truly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If I snitch about what just happened, Ria-chan's definitely gonna love me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you really think Ria-senpai would be happy if you did that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Even the Demon Lord had better bow down to yours truly while they still can.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How underhanded can you get?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeeeek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, if you're here, please say something~~. I was totally sure you'd gone home after that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no, it's quite alright. My heart is even broader than my forehead, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think there was some glue in the toolbox...」
We pick up the broken pieces together.

name: Lolotte
message: 「What brings you here, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I'm--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've got it!! You were put up to this by Senpai, weren't you~!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! I haven't even said anything yet!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa... You're going to team up with Senpai and punish me after this, aren't you?! That's it, isn't it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, I'm not!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Discretion is the better part of valor here!」
She bolted away, clutching the promotional posters tightly in her arms.

name: Paqy
message: 「Geesh, nothing but idiots around here.」

name: Synn
message: 「And I went to the trouble of finding the glue, too...」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a hopeless Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone really does have a guilty conscience, huh. Now even my heart's starting to pound.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, you're pathetic. Take a page out of Soba's book for once.」
When Nanaka heard we had the day off, she said she'd help out at home since she's been neglecting it lately. Refreshingly straightforward as always.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright... guess I'll get started too.」

name: Ria
message: 「And what might you be getting started on?」

name: Synn
message: 「Student Council work, of course--」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Wha--!」

name: Ria
message: 「What's the matter? Even though today's supposed to be a day off.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... I-I-I came to grab something I forgot...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~ Would that happen to be this half-finished list of shops? Or perhaps this cardboard for making donation boxes.」
What is this, the Gold Axe and the Silver Axe? In that case, there's only one answer.

name: Synn
message: 「It's neither of those.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then could it be this Abekawa mochi~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, that's it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Bzzzt, wrong! These are my snacks~」
So much for getting the whole set.

name: Synn
message: 「Ow.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez! Even though I told you to get some proper rest.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nobody said I wasn't resting, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「No trying to use 'I just came to hang out in the Student Council room' as an excuse, got it?」
She saw right through me.

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, Lolotte-chan... none of you ever listen to me~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk. Senpai... you knew?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. Your senpai sees right through everything♪」
Come to think of it, I didn't even hear the door open.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, have you been there the whole time--!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, come on. Never mind that, let's finish filling out this shop list.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll put the donation boxes together in the meantime. Once that's done, let's decorate them together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Can't be helped since you're already here. So let's finish up quickly and take it easy.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here, have some tea too♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, thank you.」

name: Ria
message: 「And some sweets to go with it.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, the Abekawa mochi from earlier~」

name: Ria
message: 「Gotta give a reward to a hard worker, right.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hm? What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry, I... didn't listen to what you told me, so I'm a really bad junior, aren't I.」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez. Don't worry about it♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh.」

name: Ria
message: 「If I were in your shoes, Synn-kun, I'm sure I would've done the exact same thing. So don't worry, I'm not mad anymore.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you feel that way, why did you tell me to rest?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, of course. Because I'm your senpai.」
Being a senpai really comes with a lot to juggle.
Noticing all the little things around you and being thoughtful, and looking out so your juniors don't fret or beat themselves up over things.
Even though I didn't follow her instructions, I never expected her to be this kind to me.
There's still way too much I need to learn from Ria-senpai.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, all done!」
I've got to finish what I need to do right now and keep absorbing everything I can from Senpai.

name: Ria
message: 「Then let's get to decorating the donation boxes~」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's do it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmmm, good work today~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha, it ended up taking longer than I thought.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we were taking things nice and slow, so it can't be helped. Here you go.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my. Thanks~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know if it's as good as yours, Senpai, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Any tea someone else brews for you is delicious.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「True enough.」

name: Ria
message: 「A~h. It's already starting to get dark early too~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Before you know it, winter will be here in the blink of an eye.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oooo~~spooky. Schools at night are actually pretty scary, you know~~」
Is she trying to scare me.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's nobody else here, after all. Especially today.」

name: Ria
message: 「But I feel safe because you're here with me, Synn-kun.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, I'm not exactly great with this stuff either, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「So you ARE scared!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--. I'm not scared at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see~. Well then! Wanna go outside together for a bit?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Wandering around the school building at night, singing as we go~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「What is that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's go for a walk.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「If a security guard spots us, we'll get chewed out big time!」

name: Ria
message: 「Doesn't that sound thrilling and fun?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「So, could it be that you're actually scared of dark roads at night~? E-ven though you're a boy.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not scared at all! Fine, let's go.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, it's settled!」
Urgh, even so, being somewhere with no one around really is scary.
More than that, getting spotted by someone right now is even scarier.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai... by the way, where are we going?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not scared at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody asked you that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, Synn-kun. If you don't stay a little closer, we'll get separated.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like we're in a crowd or anything.」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen carefully to what your senpai says!」
Saying that, she grabbed my wrist.

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay, I got it.」
Senpai's arm is trembling slightly.
After calling me a scaredy-cat so much, it looks like she's the one who's actually more scared.
Come to think of it, when she mistook a demon for a ghost before, she secretly fell right on her butt, too.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, if you're scared, should we head back?」

name: Ria
message: 「You're the one who's scared, Synn-kun.」
What a stubborn person.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, when it's this quiet, even I get scared.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's why I'm saying your senpai will stay right beside you so you won't be scared.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, you don't believe me at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, where are we going.」

name: Ria
message: 「Over there, over there!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's only going to get darker that way.」

name: Ria
message: 「I know that! Still, I want to go there today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Geez, don't blame me no matter what happens.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll be fine as long as I'm with you, Synn-kun.」
Why would she want to go to 'that place' so badly.
Could there be something driving Senpai forward.
Where we headed was the academy's famous landmark on the hill. Finis Tower.
The view opened up, revealing stars twinkling across the vast night sky.
If that were all, it would be no different from any ordinary scenery.
However, there is a moment that can only be seen here in Ryuusei Town.
Fleeting sparkles poured down like a gentle, drizzling rain.
A fantastical world, visible only from this spot in Ryuusei Town, spread out before my eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」

name: Ria
message: 「We're here~~♪」
It illuminated the ground even more brightly than the light of the moon.
The instant the darkness cleared and gave way to light, Ria-senpai's expression also changed into a bright smile.

name: Ria
message: 「Look, look, look~. Pretty, isn't it. This is what I wanted to see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... You can see it so clearly from up here...」
With no lights nearby, in a place as close to the sky as possible, Ria-senpai and I looked up at the heavens.

name: Synn
message: 「Have you already seen this here a few times, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. With my big sister. Back then, they weren't falling nearly this much, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see~. To think this is also thanks to Re-Crea... It feels kind of strange when I put it like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because even though it might be a threat to us, it still shows us something this beautiful.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, yeah... That's true.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since it's really an anomaly, it should be 'because of' Re-Crea, yet I end up saying 'thanks to' without thinking.」

name: Ria
message: 「Being able to think like that is one of your good points, don't you think, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「One of my...」

name: Ria
message: 「Everything you've done until now as a Crusader and Student Council President, too. When I think of it as coming from who you are, Synn-kun, it all makes sense.」

name: Synn
message: 「I still haven't caught up with a lot of things at all. It's so frustrating...」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think you need to rush so much. You just need to move forward slowly at your own pace.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. First, I want to focus on doing a solid job with what's right in front of me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah! Let's definitely make KiraFes a success.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides these shooting stars, are there any other effects caused by Re-Crea?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm... In truth, we don't really understand it well, but there is one thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh-ho.」

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon Lord appears.」

name: Synn
message: 「What!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Whenever Re-Crea draws near, the Demon Lord--the king of the Demons--has always appeared without fail.」
So the Demon Lord really is seen as a threat to the world.
If that's the reason they fear Re-Crea, there's no doubt I'll end up becoming an enemy of the Crusaders!!
Macaron seemed to have slightly different circumstances, though...
Wait a second? If that's the case, then there's nothing to worry about at all.
Because as long as I don't do anything, everything will stay peaceful.

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder... when the Demon Lord will come...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Who knows. Maybe every once in a while he doesn't even show up, right~」

name: Ria
message: 「That would be a problem in its own way!!」
So evil has to be eradicated after all~~!! Are Ria-senpai and I fated to fight!?
I can't imagine it at all, and I don't even have a reason to fight, though...
Actually, Dad. It's a miracle you managed to survive.

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, what do you think you're doing~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis.」

name: Helena
message: 「My, my, you're quite the smooth operator, Synn-chan. Bringing Ria all the way out here--what kind of naughty things are you planning?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--we're just taking a walk.」

name: Helena
message: 「'A mistake of youth... huh. Not a line meant for some brat who doesn't even know the meaning of limits'」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, stop teasing Synn-kun. He's telling the truth, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「I know, I know~\s04 You came here because you wanted to see the shooting stars, right.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, to think you went out of your way to make Synn-chan your bodyguard just because you were too scared to go alone.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sis!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, did I hit the nail on the head?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's not like that wasn't part of it, but... that's not the only reason! I wanted to show it to Synn-kun!」

name: Helena
message: 「Right, right, uh-huh. Ria is such a kind senior who cares so much about her junior~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai... thank you very much.」

name: Ria
message: 「B-But because you keep teasing me, Sis, I've completely lost face as his senior.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. To me, you're still the senior I respect, no matter what.」

name: Ria
message: 「E-Even if you say that... jeez, I don't care anymore.」

name: Helena
message: 「Aaaah! You're getting all shy, you're just SO cute~~!」

name: Ria
message: 「Honestly, Sis!」

name: Helena
message: 「Stop pinching me~」
It doesn't look like it's working at all.

name: Synn
message: 「Speaking of which, Helena-san, what are you doing in a place like this?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm, just a little something with Melilot.」

name: Synn
message: 「With Melilot-san...?」
Coming to look at the stars with another woman--could they be in that kind of relationship?

name: Helena
message: 「What kind of naughty things are you imagining?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not imagining anything!」

name: Helena
message: 「It's fine, you're young, so go ahead and fantasize lots and lots more.」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, that's enough. It's one thing if it's just me, but please stop teasing Synn-kun too.」

name: Helena
message: 「Lucky you~. Having such a great senior by your side.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Flattering me now is way too late. Hmph.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm done with my business, and you two have had your fun too, right? Let's head back before it gets too late.」

name: Ria
message: 「Why don't you just walk home by yourself, Sis~?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, my. Since it seems she wants to be alone, let's walk home together, Synn-chan♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, wha--」

name: Helena
message: 「Bye-bye, Ria~~. Be careful out there~~. Walking alone at night is super scary and dangerous, you know~~」

name: Ria
message: 「You're so mean, Sis~~!」
In the end, the three of them headed home together noisily.
